catalysts.name: Marvell Technology, Inc.
catalysts.what: TD Cowen upgraded Marvell to Buy from Hold on 7 Oct and raised its price target to $350 from $245 (new target implies 20%+ upside from the stock's level that day), citing custom-chip/XPU concentration risk as largely de-risked and a stronger connectivity franchise after Marvell's 6 Oct Investor Day, where it also lifted its FY2028 revenue goal to $20B from $18B. RBC and Jefferies also raised targets on the same Investor Day (to $425 and $450 respectively) but a reconciled analyst-average target isn't available, so only the TD Cowen target is cited.

catalysts.name: UnitedHealth Group Incorporated
catalysts.what: UnitedHealth's Q3 2026 report (13 Oct) showed adjusted EPS of $4.69, above the roughly $4.10 pre-report consensus, and the company raised full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to at least $20.50, up from the $19.50–$20.00 range it set in July. Initial coverage described shares climbing on the print before paring the move intraday — not a clean sell-the-news, but noted here.

catalysts.name: Haemonetics Corporation
catalysts.what: CSL Plasma disclosed in an SEC filing that it expects to put Haemonetics' NexSys PCS devices in all of its current US plasma-collection centers by end-2027, a much larger commitment than the open-ended, partial-scope supply deal disclosed 18 Aug; scope/timing remain subject to change and Haemonetics is not updating FY2027 guidance yet. BTIG raised its price target to $130 from $110 (Buy) on the news — a single broker, not a consensus.

MRVL.what: Fabless semiconductor company designing data-center, networking, custom AI/ASIC and connectivity chips.

UNH.what: Diversified health-insurance and health-services company spanning UnitedHealthcare and Optum.

HAE.what: Medical device company providing plasma-collection (NexSys PCS), blood-center and hospital hemostasis/coagulation-testing systems.
